top_signals.title: Rate Volatility Might Shake Fundamentals: Tannuzzo
top_signals.summary: Gene Tannuzzo, global head of fixed income at Columbia Threadneedle Investments, and Subadra Rajappa, head of research at Société Générale Americas, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Treasuries led a global bond rally as a selloff in artificial-intelligence shares deepened, spurring demand for havens from a growth slowdown. (Source: Bloomberg)
